purpose: Define a deterministic apparel Style/SPU and two-color by three-size canonical SKU matrix, execute its governed lifecycle to ACTIVE, then prove idempotency and lakehouse lineage.
environment_policy: local or disposable test tenant only
invariants: tenant comes from the trusted request context, never the payload
business codes are normalized before persistence
Brand and Category references remain source-qualified until their canonical domains exist
Style, SPU, Color, SizeGroup, Size, SKU, Barcode, operation result, and Outbox commit atomically
same idempotency key and payload returns the immutable first result
same run_id replay creates no new aggregate, barcode, operation, or event
definition responses expose the current status and optimistic version of every shared entity
tenant-level Color, SizeGroup, and Size are activated only when DRAFT and reused when already ACTIVE
Style becomes ACTIVE, SPU follows DRAFT to SUBMITTED to APPROVED to ACTIVE, and all six SKU become ACTIVE
ACTIVE Catalog status still does not imply Pricing, Listing, or channel publication
StarRocks reconciles to one Style, one SPU, six active SKU, two colors, three sizes, and CATALOG_ACTIVE
cleanup: none; use run-scoped business codes and retain records plus ledgers as audit evidence
